senses.definition: n.pr.m. (according to DlBaer, Dan. xi for Mîsha-aku ‘who is what Aku (the moon-god) is?’ cf. מִישָׁאֵל, p. 567);—the new (Bab.) name given to Mishael, Dn 1:7 (+ Aramaic 2:49 and c. 3).
